object.attr: stakeholder: a requirements repository can also hold source code, documentation and CI files, as Mellon's own repository does. The exceptions are folders that look like damaged documents, which are reported instead (CF-S6, CF-S7).
object.description: Mellon shall ignore a folder directly under the repository root that holds no file whose name is <folder name>.xml when letter case is ignored, and no file objects/<folder name>-<n>.xml or links/<folder name>-<n>.xml.
